text: Refunds are issued within 5 business days to the original payment method once the returned item is received.
To request a refund, open a ticket with your order number and reason; approved refunds post in 5 business days.
Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days. Express shipping is delivered the next business day.
Orders placed before 2 PM ship the same day. Tracking numbers are emailed once the carrier scans the parcel.
The standard warranty covers manufacturing defects for 12 months from the purchase date.
Warranty claims require the original receipt and a description of the defect submitted through the support portal.
API authentication uses OAuth2 bearer tokens. Tokens expire after 60 minutes and must be refreshed.
To rotate an API key, generate a new key in the console, update your client, then revoke the old key.
The default API rate limit is 100 requests per minute per key. Exceeding it returns HTTP 429.
To reset your password, use the 'Forgot password' link; a reset email is valid for 30 minutes.
Passwords must be at least 12 characters and include a number and a symbol.
Subscriptions renew monthly on the date of initial signup. Invoices are emailed the same day.
Refunds go back to your original payment method within five business days after we receive the returned item.
Once the returned product reaches us, your refund is processed to the original payment method within 5 business days.
Under GDPR, users may request deletion of their personal data; we complete verified deletion requests within 30 days.
Late fees of 1.5 percent per month apply to overdue invoices that remain unpaid after 30 days.

Our office is open 9 to 5 on weekdays. Separately, the mobile app supports biometric login on iOS and Android. Also, bulk export of your data is available in CSV and JSON from the account settings page under 'Data'.
Gift cards never expire and can be applied to any order at checkout.
Referral credits are added to your account within 24 hours of your friend's first purchase.
You can cancel your subscription at any time; access continues until the end of the current billing period.
You can cancel an order any time before it ships; access to the item ends immediately once cancelled.
